title: How your area has changed in 10 years: Census 2021
meta_description: Find out what changed for people living in local authority areas within England or Wales between the 2011 and 2021 census, includes population, work and family.

breadcrumb.text: How your area has changed in 10 years: Census 2021

lede: Find out how life changed for people living in different local authority areas in England and Wales.
